'''Crimson Sign''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from <span class="explain" title="Crimson Stem, Stripped Crimson Stem, Crimson Hyphae, Stripped Crimson Hyphae">any crimson stems</span>). See {{MCW|Crimson Sign}} for everything else.
